+int runSimulation(DeviceState& state, const Partition& partition, int n, int n_iters,
+                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
+    cudaStream_t compute_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaStream_t communication_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t update_complete = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t halos_ready = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&update_complete, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+
+    const bool staged_halos = !cuda_aware_mpi &&
+                              (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+                               partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL);
+    HostHalos host_halos(n, staged_halos);
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const dim3 threads(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    const dim3 column_blocks((n + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    int current = 0;
+
+    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < n_iters; ++iteration) {
+        const int next = 1 - current;
+        val_t* current_energy = state.energy[current];
+        val_t* current_flux = state.total_flux[current];
+        val_t* next_energy = state.energy[next];
+        val_t* next_flux = state.total_flux[next];
+
+        if (partition.previous_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL &&
+            partition.next_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 0, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+            current = next;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        if (cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            // MPI may not observe work in a non-default CUDA stream, so make only
+            // the preceding boundary update visible before handing it pointers.
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 18,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy + n, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 17,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        } else {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communication_stream, update_complete, 0));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_previous,
+                                           current_energy + n, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_next,
+                                           current_energy +
+                                               static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                           row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows do not depend on incoming halos and overlap communication.
+        if (partition.rows > 2) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows - 2);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 1, partition.rows - 2, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        }
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communication_stream));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(current_energy,
+                                           host_halos.receive_previous, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
+                    current_energy + static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                    host_halos.receive_next, row_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                    communication_stream));
+            }
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready, communication_stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream, halos_ready, 0));
+        }
+
+        const unsigned int boundary_rows = partition.rows == 1 ? 1U : 2U;
+        const dim3 boundary_grid(column_blocks.x, boundary_rows);
+        updateBoundaryRowsKernel<<<boundary_grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+            current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+            n, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+        current = next;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream));
+    return current;
+}

+uint64_t doubleBits(val_t value) {
+    uint64_t bits = 0;
+    static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value));
+    std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
+    return bits;
 }

+uint64_t computeDistributedHash(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                                const std::vector<val_t>& total_flux,
+                                size_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t local_hash = 0;
+    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : local_hash)
+    for (int64_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const uint64_t global_index = global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(i);
+        local_hash ^= (doubleBits(energy[i]) + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        local_hash ^= (doubleBits(total_flux[i]) + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    }
+    return local_hash;
+}

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                         const std::vector<val_t>& total_flux, int rank) {
+    val_t local_energy_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t local_flux_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t local_energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
+    val_t local_energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
+    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : local_energy_sum, local_flux_sum) \
+    reduction(max : local_energy_max) reduction(min : local_energy_min)
+    for (int64_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        local_energy_sum += energy[i];
+        local_flux_sum += total_flux[i];
+        local_energy_max = std::max(local_energy_max, energy[i]);
+        local_energy_min = std::min(local_energy_min, energy[i]);
+    }
+
+    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t energy_max = 0.0;
+    val_t energy_min = 0.0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_sum, &energy_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_flux_sum, &flux_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_max, &energy_max, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_min, &energy_min, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        std::printf("Validation results:\n");
+        std::printf("  Energy sum: %.12f\n", energy_sum);
+        std::printf("  Flux sum: %.2f\n", flux_sum);
+        std::printf("  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", energy_min, energy_max);
+        if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(energy_sum) > 1e-8) {
+            std::printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
+        }
+        if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (valid) {
+            std::printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
+        }
     }
-    return hash;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return valid != 0;
 }

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_next), bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_previous), bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_next), bytes));
     }

-        printf("  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\n");
-        return false;

+    ~HostHalos() {
+        if (send_previous != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_previous);
+        if (send_next != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(send_next);
+        if (receive_previous != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_previous);
+        if (receive_next != nullptr) cudaFreeHost(receive_next);

-    return true;

+    HostHalos(const HostHalos&) = delete;
+    HostHalos& operator=(const HostHalos&) = delete;
+};

+int runSimulation(DeviceState& state, const Partition& partition, int n, int n_iters,
+                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
+    cudaStream_t compute_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaStream_t communication_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t update_complete = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t halos_ready = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&update_complete, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+
+    const bool staged_halos = !cuda_aware_mpi &&
+                              (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+                               partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL);
+    HostHalos host_halos(n, staged_halos);
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const dim3 threads(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    const dim3 column_blocks((n + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    int current = 0;
+
+    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < n_iters; ++iteration) {
+        const int next = 1 - current;
+        val_t* current_energy = state.energy[current];
+        val_t* current_flux = state.total_flux[current];
+        val_t* next_energy = state.energy[next];
+        val_t* next_flux = state.total_flux[next];
+
+        if (partition.previous_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL &&
+            partition.next_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 0, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+            current = next;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        if (cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            // MPI may not observe work in a non-default CUDA stream, so make only
+            // the preceding boundary update visible before handing it pointers.
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 18,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy + n, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 17,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        } else {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communication_stream, update_complete, 0));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_previous,
+                                           current_energy + n, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_next,
+                                           current_energy +
+                                               static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                           row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows do not depend on incoming halos and overlap communication.
+        if (partition.rows > 2) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows - 2);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 1, partition.rows - 2, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        }
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communication_stream));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(current_energy,
+                                           host_halos.receive_previous, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
+                    current_energy + static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                    host_halos.receive_next, row_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                    communication_stream));
+            }
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready, communication_stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream, halos_ready, 0));
+        }
+
+        const unsigned int boundary_rows = partition.rows == 1 ? 1U : 2U;
+        const dim3 boundary_grid(column_blocks.x, boundary_rows);
+        updateBoundaryRowsKernel<<<boundary_grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+            current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+            n, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+        current = next;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream));
+    return current;
+}

+uint64_t doubleBits(val_t value) {
+    uint64_t bits = 0;
+    static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value));
+    std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
+    return bits;
 }

-uint64_t computeHash(const std::vector<ElementDynamic>& elements) {

+uint64_t computeDistributedHash(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                                const std::vector<val_t>& total_flux,
+                                size_t global_offset) {
+    uint64_t local_hash = 0;
+    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : local_hash)
+    for (int64_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        const uint64_t global_index = global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(i);
+        local_hash ^= (doubleBits(energy[i]) + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
+        local_hash ^= (doubleBits(total_flux[i]) + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
+    }
+    return local_hash;
+}

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                         const std::vector<val_t>& total_flux, int rank) {
+    val_t local_energy_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t local_flux_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t local_energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
+    val_t local_energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
+    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : local_energy_sum, local_flux_sum) \
+    reduction(max : local_energy_max) reduction(min : local_energy_min)
+    for (int64_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
+        local_energy_sum += energy[i];
+        local_flux_sum += total_flux[i];
+        local_energy_max = std::max(local_energy_max, energy[i]);
+        local_energy_min = std::min(local_energy_min, energy[i]);
+    }
+
+    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t energy_max = 0.0;
+    val_t energy_min = 0.0;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_sum, &energy_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_flux_sum, &flux_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_max, &energy_max, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_min, &energy_min, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        std::printf("Validation results:\n");
+        std::printf("  Energy sum: %.12f\n", energy_sum);
+        std::printf("  Flux sum: %.2f\n", flux_sum);
+        std::printf("  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", energy_min, energy_max);
+        if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(energy_sum) > 1e-8) {
+            std::printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
+        }
+        if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (valid) {
+            std::printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
+        }
     }
-    return hash;
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    return valid != 0;
 }

+int runSimulation(DeviceState& state, const Partition& partition, int n, int n_iters,
+                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
+    cudaStream_t compute_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaStream_t communication_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t update_complete = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t halos_ready = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&update_complete, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+
+    const bool staged_halos = !cuda_aware_mpi &&
+                              (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+                               partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL);
+    HostHalos host_halos(n, staged_halos);
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const dim3 threads(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    const dim3 column_blocks((n + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    int current = 0;
+
+    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < n_iters; ++iteration) {
+        const int next = 1 - current;
+        val_t* current_energy = state.energy[current];
+        val_t* current_flux = state.total_flux[current];
+        val_t* next_energy = state.energy[next];
+        val_t* next_flux = state.total_flux[next];
+
+        if (partition.previous_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL &&
+            partition.next_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 0, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+            current = next;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        if (cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            // MPI may not observe work in a non-default CUDA stream, so make only
+            // the preceding boundary update visible before handing it pointers.
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 18,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy + n, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 17,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        } else {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communication_stream, update_complete, 0));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_previous,
+                                           current_energy + n, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_next,
+                                           current_energy +
+                                               static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                           row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows do not depend on incoming halos and overlap communication.
+        if (partition.rows > 2) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows - 2);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 1, partition.rows - 2, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        }
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communication_stream));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(current_energy,
+                                           host_halos.receive_previous, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
+                    current_energy + static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                    host_halos.receive_next, row_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                    communication_stream));
+            }
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready, communication_stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream, halos_ready, 0));
+        }
+
+        const unsigned int boundary_rows = partition.rows == 1 ? 1U : 2U;
+        const dim3 boundary_grid(column_blocks.x, boundary_rows);
+        updateBoundaryRowsKernel<<<boundary_grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+            current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+            n, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+        current = next;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream));
+    return current;
+}

+uint64_t doubleBits(val_t value) {
+    uint64_t bits = 0;
+    static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value));
+    std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
+    return bits;

+bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
+                         const std::vector<val_t>& total_flux, int rank) {
+    val_t local_energy_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t local_flux_sum = 0.0;

+    val_t local_energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
+    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
+
+#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : local_energy_sum, local_flux_sum) \
+    reduction(max : local_energy_max) reduction(min : local_energy_min)

+        local_flux_sum += total_flux[i];
+        local_energy_max = std::max(local_energy_max, energy[i]);
+        local_energy_min = std::min(local_energy_min, energy[i]);

+    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;
+    val_t energy_max = 0.0;
+    val_t energy_min = 0.0;

+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_flux_sum, &flux_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_max, &energy_max, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_min, &energy_min, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN,
+                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
+
+    int valid = 1;
+    if (rank == 0) {
+        std::printf("Validation results:\n");
+        std::printf("  Energy sum: %.12f\n", energy_sum);
+        std::printf("  Flux sum: %.2f\n", flux_sum);
+        std::printf("  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", energy_min, energy_max);
+        if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (std::abs(energy_sum) > 1e-8) {
+            std::printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
+        }
+        if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (!std::isfinite(energy_max) || !std::isfinite(energy_min)) {
+            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy extrema are not finite\n");
+            valid = 0;
+        }
+        if (valid) {
+            std::printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
+        }
     }

+Partition makePartition(int n, int rank, int ranks) {
+    const int rows_per_rank = n / ranks;
+    const int remainder = n % ranks;
+    const int rows = rows_per_rank + (rank < remainder ? 1 : 0);
+    const int first_row = rank * rows_per_rank + std::min(rank, remainder);
+    return {first_row, rows,
+            rank == 0 ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank - 1,
+            rank + 1 == ranks ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ current_energy,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ current_total_flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_total_flux,
+    int n, int local_row, int global_first_row, int column) {
+    const int global_row = global_first_row + local_row;
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row + 1) * n + column;
+    const val_t energy = current_energy[index];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Retain the original connection order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index + n] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index - n] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index + 1] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index - 1] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = energy + flux;
+    next_total_flux[index] = current_total_flux[index] + fabs(flux);
 }

+struct DeviceState {

+struct HostHalos {
+    val_t* send_previous = nullptr;
+    val_t* send_next = nullptr;
+    val_t* receive_previous = nullptr;
+    val_t* receive_next = nullptr;
+
+    HostHalos(int n, bool needed) {
+        if (!needed) {
+            return;
+        }
+        const size_t bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_previous), bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&send_next), bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_previous), bytes));
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&receive_next), bytes));

+int runSimulation(DeviceState& state, const Partition& partition, int n, int n_iters,
+                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
+    cudaStream_t compute_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaStream_t communication_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t update_complete = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t halos_ready = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&update_complete, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+
+    const bool staged_halos = !cuda_aware_mpi &&
+                              (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+                               partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL);
+    HostHalos host_halos(n, staged_halos);
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const dim3 threads(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    const dim3 column_blocks((n + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    int current = 0;
+
+    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < n_iters; ++iteration) {
+        const int next = 1 - current;
+        val_t* current_energy = state.energy[current];
+        val_t* current_flux = state.total_flux[current];
+        val_t* next_energy = state.energy[next];
+        val_t* next_flux = state.total_flux[next];
+
+        if (partition.previous_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL &&
+            partition.next_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 0, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+            current = next;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        if (cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            // MPI may not observe work in a non-default CUDA stream, so make only
+            // the preceding boundary update visible before handing it pointers.
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 18,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy + n, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 17,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        } else {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communication_stream, update_complete, 0));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_previous,
+                                           current_energy + n, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_next,
+                                           current_energy +
+                                               static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                           row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows do not depend on incoming halos and overlap communication.
+        if (partition.rows > 2) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows - 2);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 1, partition.rows - 2, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        }
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communication_stream));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(current_energy,
+                                           host_halos.receive_previous, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
+                    current_energy + static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                    host_halos.receive_next, row_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                    communication_stream));
+            }
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready, communication_stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream, halos_ready, 0));
+        }
+
+        const unsigned int boundary_rows = partition.rows == 1 ? 1U : 2U;
+        const dim3 boundary_grid(column_blocks.x, boundary_rows);
+        updateBoundaryRowsKernel<<<boundary_grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+            current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,

+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+        current = next;
+    }

+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream));
+    return current;

    62	Partition makePartition(int n, int rank, int ranks) {
    63	    const int rows_per_rank = n / ranks;
    64	    const int remainder = n % ranks;
    65	    const int rows = rows_per_rank + (rank < remainder ? 1 : 0);
    66	    const int first_row = rank * rows_per_rank + std::min(rank, remainder);
    67	    return {first_row, rows,

    69	            rank + 1 == ranks ? MPI_PROC_NULL : rank + 1};

    80	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t externalFlow(int global_row, int column, int n) {
    81	    if ((global_row == 0 && column == 0) ||
    82	        (global_row == n - 1 && column == n - 1)) {
    83	        return INFLOW;
    84	    }
    85	    if ((global_row == 0 && column == n - 1) ||
    86	        (global_row == n - 1 && column == 0)) {
    87	        return OUTFLOW;
    88	    }
    89	    return 0.0;

   108	        flux += (current_energy[index - n] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
   109	    }
   110	    if (column + 1 < n) {
   111	        flux += (current_energy[index + 1] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
   112	    }
   113	    if (column > 0) {
   114	        flux += (current_energy[index - 1] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
   115	    }
   116	
   117	    next_energy[index] = energy + flux;
   118	    next_total_flux[index] = current_total_flux[index] + fabs(flux);
   119	}
   120	
   121	__global__ void updateRowsKernel(
   122	    const val_t* __restrict__ current_energy,
   123	    const val_t* __restrict__ current_total_flux,
   124	    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
   125	    val_t* __restrict__ next_total_flux,
   126	    int n, int first_local_row, int row_count, int global_first_row) {
   127	    const int column = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   128	    const int row_offset = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y);
   129	    if (column < n && row_offset < row_count) {
   130	        updateElement(current_energy, current_total_flux, next_energy, next_total_flux,
   131	                      n, first_local_row + row_offset, global_first_row, column);
   132	    }
   133	}
   134	
   135	__global__ void updateBoundaryRowsKernel(
   136	    const val_t* __restrict__ current_energy,
   137	    const val_t* __restrict__ current_total_flux,
   138	    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
   139	    val_t* __restrict__ next_total_flux,
   140	    int n, int local_rows, int global_first_row) {
   141	    const int column = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   142	    if (column >= n) {
   143	        return;
   144	    }
   145	    const int local_row = blockIdx.y == 0 ? 0 : local_rows - 1;
   146	    updateElement(current_energy, current_total_flux, next_energy, next_total_flux,
   147	                  n, local_row, global_first_row, column);
   148	}
   149	
   150	struct DeviceState {
   151	    val_t* energy[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};
   152	    val_t* total_flux[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};
   153	    size_t values = 0;
   154	
   155	    explicit DeviceState(size_t value_count) : values(value_count) {
   156	        const size_t bytes = values * sizeof(val_t);
   157	        for (int buffer = 0; buffer < 2; ++buffer) {
   158	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&energy[buffer]), bytes));
   159	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&total_flux[buffer]), bytes));
   160	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(energy[buffer], 0, bytes));
   161	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(total_flux[buffer], 0, bytes));
   162	        }
   163	    }
   164	
   165	    ~DeviceState() {
   166	        for (int buffer = 0; buffer < 2; ++buffer) {
   167	            if (energy[buffer] != nullptr) {
   168	                cudaFree(energy[buffer]);
   169	            }
   170	            if (total_flux[buffer] != nullptr) {
   171	                cudaFree(total_flux[buffer]);
   172	            }
   173	        }
   174	    }
   175	
   176	    DeviceState(const DeviceState&) = delete;
   177	    DeviceState& operator=(const DeviceState&) = delete;
   178	};
   179	
   180	struct HostHalos {
   210	    cudaStream_t compute_stream = nullptr;
   211	    cudaStream_t communication_stream = nullptr;
   212	    cudaEvent_t update_complete = nullptr;
   213	    cudaEvent_t halos_ready = nullptr;
   214	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   215	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   216	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&update_complete, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   217	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready, cudaEventDisableTiming));
   218	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
   219	
   220	    const bool staged_halos = !cuda_aware_mpi &&
   221	                              (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
   222	                               partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL);
   223	    HostHalos host_halos(n, staged_halos);
   224	    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
   225	    const dim3 threads(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
   226	    const dim3 column_blocks((n + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
   227	    int current = 0;
   228	
   229	    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < n_iters; ++iteration) {
   230	        const int next = 1 - current;
   231	        val_t* current_energy = state.energy[current];
   232	        val_t* current_flux = state.total_flux[current];
   233	        val_t* next_energy = state.energy[next];
   234	        val_t* next_flux = state.total_flux[next];
   235	
   236	        if (partition.previous_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL &&
   237	            partition.next_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   238	            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows);
   239	            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
   240	                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
   241	                n, 0, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
   242	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   243	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
   244	            current = next;
   245	            continue;
   246	        }
   247	
   248	        MPI_Request requests[4];
   249	        int request_count = 0;
   250	
   251	        if (cuda_aware_mpi) {
   252	            // MPI may not observe work in a non-default CUDA stream, so make only
   253	            // the preceding boundary update visible before handing it pointers.
   254	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
   255	            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   256	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
   257	                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   258	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   259	            }
   260	            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   261	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy +
   262	                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
   263	                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 18,
   264	                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
   265	            }
   266	            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   267	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy + n, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
   268	                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   269	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   270	            }
   271	            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   272	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy +
   273	                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
   274	                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 17,
   275	                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
   276	            }
   277	        } else {
   278	            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   279	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
   280	                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   281	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   282	            }
   283	            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   284	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
   285	                                    partition.next_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   286	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   287	            }
   288	
   289	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communication_stream, update_complete, 0));
   290	            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   291	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_previous,
   292	                                           current_energy + n, row_bytes,
   293	                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   294	                                           communication_stream));
   295	            }
   296	            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   297	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_next,
   298	                                           current_energy +
   299	                                               static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
   300	                                           row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
   301	                                           communication_stream));
   302	            }
   303	        }
   304	
   305	        // Interior rows do not depend on incoming halos and overlap communication.
   306	        if (partition.rows > 2) {
   307	            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows - 2);
   308	            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
   309	                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
   310	                n, 1, partition.rows - 2, partition.first_row);
   311	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   312	        }
   313	
   314	        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
   315	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communication_stream));
   316	            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   317	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
   318	                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   319	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   320	            }
   321	            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   322	                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
   323	                                    partition.next_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
   324	                                    &requests[request_count++]));
   325	            }
   326	        }
   327	
   328	        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
   329	
   330	        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
   331	            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   332	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(current_energy,
   333	                                           host_halos.receive_previous, row_bytes,
   334	                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
   335	                                           communication_stream));
   336	            }
   337	            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
   338	                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
   339	                    current_energy + static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
   340	                    host_halos.receive_next, row_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
   341	                    communication_stream));
   342	            }
   343	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready, communication_stream));
   344	            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream, halos_ready, 0));
   345	        }
   346	
   347	        const unsigned int boundary_rows = partition.rows == 1 ? 1U : 2U;
   348	        const dim3 boundary_grid(column_blocks.x, boundary_rows);
   349	        updateBoundaryRowsKernel<<<boundary_grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
   350	            current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
   351	            n, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
   352	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   353	        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
   354	        current = next;
   355	    }
   356	
   357	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
   358	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready));
   359	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(update_complete));
   360	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream));
   361	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream));
   362	    return current;
   363	}
   364	
   365	uint64_t doubleBits(val_t value) {
   366	    uint64_t bits = 0;
   367	    static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value));
   368	    std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
   369	    return bits;
   370	}
   371	
   372	uint64_t computeDistributedHash(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
   373	                                const std::vector<val_t>& total_flux,
   374	                                size_t global_offset) {
   375	    uint64_t local_hash = 0;
   376	    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
   377	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(^ : local_hash)
   378	    for (int64_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
   379	        const uint64_t global_index = global_offset + static_cast<uint64_t>(i);
   380	        local_hash ^= (doubleBits(energy[i]) + global_index) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
   381	        local_hash ^= (doubleBits(total_flux[i]) + global_index) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
   382	    }
   383	    return local_hash;
   384	}
   385	
   386	bool validateDistributed(const std::vector<val_t>& energy,
   387	                         const std::vector<val_t>& total_flux, int rank) {
   388	    val_t local_energy_sum = 0.0;
   389	    val_t local_flux_sum = 0.0;
   390	    val_t local_energy_max = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
   391	    val_t local_energy_min = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   392	    const int64_t count = static_cast<int64_t>(energy.size());
   393	
   394	#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(+ : local_energy_sum, local_flux_sum) \
   395	    reduction(max : local_energy_max) reduction(min : local_energy_min)
   396	    for (int64_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
   397	        local_energy_sum += energy[i];
   398	        local_flux_sum += total_flux[i];
   399	        local_energy_max = std::max(local_energy_max, energy[i]);
   400	        local_energy_min = std::min(local_energy_min, energy[i]);
   401	    }
   402	
   403	    val_t energy_sum = 0.0;
   404	    val_t flux_sum = 0.0;
   405	    val_t energy_max = 0.0;
   406	    val_t energy_min = 0.0;
   407	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_sum, &energy_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM,
   408	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   409	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_flux_sum, &flux_sum, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM,
   410	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   411	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_max, &energy_max, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
   412	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   413	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_energy_min, &energy_min, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN,
   414	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   415	
   416	    int valid = 1;
   417	    if (rank == 0) {
   418	        std::printf("Validation results:\n");
   419	        std::printf("  Energy sum: %.12f\n", energy_sum);
   420	        std::printf("  Flux sum: %.2f\n", flux_sum);
   421	        std::printf("  Energy range: [%.6f, %.6f]\n", energy_min, energy_max);
   422	        if (!std::isfinite(energy_sum)) {
   423	            std::printf("  ERROR: Energy sum is not finite\n");
   424	            valid = 0;
   425	        }
   426	        if (std::abs(energy_sum) > 1e-8) {
   427	            std::printf("  WARNING: Energy sum diverged from 0 (expected conservation)\n");
   428	        }
   429	        if (!std::isfinite(flux_sum)) {
   430	            std::printf("  ERROR: Flux sum is not finite\n");
   450	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   451	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   452	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   453	}
   454	
   455	}  // namespace
   456	
   457	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   458	    int provided_thread_level = MPI_THREAD_SINGLE;
   459	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided_thread_level));
   460	
   461	    int rank_count = 1;
   462	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &world_rank));
   463	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank_count));
   464	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_RETURN));
   465	
   466	    if (provided_thread_level < MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED) {
   467	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   468	            std::fprintf(stderr, "MPI implementation does not provide MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED\n");
   469	        }
   470	        MPI_Finalize();
   471	        return 1;
   472	    }
   473	
   474	    int n = 512;
   475	    int n_iters = 10;
   476	    bool validate = false;
   477	    bool print_results_requested = false;
   478	    bool show_help = false;
   479	    bool arguments_valid = true;
   480	
   481	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   482	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   483	            n = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   484	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-i") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   485	            n_iters = std::atoi(argv[++i]);
   486	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   487	            validate = true;
   488	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   489	            print_results_requested = true;
   490	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   491	            show_help = true;
   492	        } else {
   493	            if (world_rank == 0) {
   494	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   495	            }
   496	            arguments_valid = false;
   497	        }
   498	    }
   499	
   500	    constexpr int max_grid_root = 46340;
   501	    if (n <= 0 || n > max_grid_root || n_iters < 0 || rank_count > n) {
   502	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   503	            std::fprintf(stderr,
   504	                         "Grid size must be in [1, %d], iterations must be nonnegative, "
   505	                         "and MPI ranks cannot exceed grid rows.\n",
   506	                         max_grid_root);
   507	        }
   508	        arguments_valid = false;
   509	    }
   510	    if (show_help || !arguments_valid) {
   511	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   512	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   513	        }
   514	        MPI_Finalize();
   515	        return arguments_valid ? 0 : 1;
   516	    }
   517	
   518	    MPI_Comm local_communicator = MPI_COMM_NULL;
   519	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED,
   520	                                  world_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local_communicator));
   521	    int local_rank = 0;
   522	    int local_rank_count = 1;
   523	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(local_communicator, &local_rank));
   524	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(local_communicator, &local_rank_count));
   525	
   526	    int device_count = 0;
   527	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&device_count));
   528	    if (device_count == 0) {
   529	        if (world_rank == 0) {
   530	            std::fprintf(stderr, "No CUDA devices are available; CUDA execution is required.\n");
   531	        }
   532	        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
   533	    }
   534	    const int device = local_rank % device_count;
   535	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));
   536	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));
   537	
   538	    cudaDeviceProp device_properties{};
   539	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&device_properties, device));
   540	    const bool cuda_aware_mpi = cudaAwareMpiAvailable();
   541	    const Partition partition = makePartition(n, world_rank, rank_count);
   542	    const size_t global_elements = static_cast<size_t>(n) * n;
   543	    const size_t local_elements = static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n;
   544	    const size_t device_values = static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 2) * n;
   545	
   546	    if (world_rank == 0) {
   547	        std::printf("Unstructured Mesh Energy Transfer Benchmark\n");
   548	        std::printf("============================================\n");
   549	        std::printf("Grid size: %d x %d = %zu elements\n", n, n, global_elements);
   550	        std::printf("Iterations: %d\n", n_iters);
   551	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   552	        std::printf("MPI ranks: %d\n", rank_count);
   553	        std::printf("OpenMP threads/rank: %d\n", omp_get_max_threads());
   554	        std::printf("CUDA device 0: %s\n", device_properties.name);
   555	        std::printf("CUDA-aware MPI: %s (pinned host staging %s)\n",
   556	                    cuda_aware_mpi ? "enabled" : "unavailable",
   557	                    cuda_aware_mpi ? "disabled" : "enabled");
   558	        if (local_rank_count > device_count) {
   559	            std::printf("WARNING: %d local MPI ranks share %d CUDA device(s).\n",
   560	                        local_rank_count, device_count);
   561	        }
   562	        std::printf("\nBuilding distributed unstructured mesh...\n");
   563	    }
   564	
   565	    DeviceState state(device_values);
   566	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   567	
   568	    const uint64_t local_device_bytes = 4ULL * device_values * sizeof(val_t);
   569	    uint64_t total_device_bytes = 0;
   570	    uint64_t maximum_device_bytes = 0;
   571	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_device_bytes, &total_device_bytes, 1, MPI_UINT64_T,
   572	                         MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   573	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_device_bytes, &maximum_device_bytes, 1, MPI_UINT64_T,
   574	                         MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   575	    if (world_rank == 0) {
   576	        std::printf("Device memory: %.2f MB aggregate (%.2f MB maximum/rank)\n\n",
   577	                    total_device_bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0),
   578	                    maximum_device_bytes / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
   579	        std::printf("Running simulation...\n");
   580	    }
   581	
   582	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   583	    const double start_time = MPI_Wtime();
   584	    const int final_buffer = runSimulation(state, partition, n, n_iters, cuda_aware_mpi);
   585	    const double local_elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start_time;
   586	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   587	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_elapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX,
   588	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   589	
   590	    std::vector<val_t> local_energy(local_elements);
   591	    std::vector<val_t> local_total_flux(local_elements);
   592	    const size_t local_bytes = local_elements * sizeof(val_t);
   593	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local_energy.data(), state.energy[final_buffer] + n,
   594	                          local_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   595	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(local_total_flux.data(), state.total_flux[final_buffer] + n,
   596	                          local_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   597	
   598	    const size_t global_offset = static_cast<size_t>(partition.first_row) * n;
   599	    const uint64_t local_hash =
   600	        computeDistributedHash(local_energy, local_total_flux, global_offset);
   601	    uint64_t result_hash = 0;
   602	    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Reduce(&local_hash, &result_hash, 1, MPI_UINT64_T, MPI_BXOR,
   603	                         0, MPI_COMM_WORLD));
   604	
   605	    if (world_rank == 0) {
   606	        const double duration_ms = elapsed * 1000.0;
   607	        const double time_per_iteration = n_iters > 0 ? duration_ms / n_iters : 0.0;
   608	        const double giga_elements_per_second =
   609	            elapsed > 0.0 ? (static_cast<double>(n_iters) * global_elements) /
   610	                                elapsed / 1.0e9
   611	                          : 0.0;

+Partition makePartition(int n, int rank, int ranks) {
+    const int rows_per_rank = n / ranks;

+__device__ __forceinline__ void updateElement(
+    const val_t* __restrict__ current_energy,
+    const val_t* __restrict__ current_total_flux,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_energy,
+    val_t* __restrict__ next_total_flux,
+    int n, int local_row, int global_first_row, int column) {
+    const int global_row = global_first_row + local_row;
+    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(local_row + 1) * n + column;
+    const val_t energy = current_energy[index];
+    val_t flux = externalFlow(global_row, column, n);
+
+    // Retain the original connection order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
+    if (global_row + 1 < n) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index + n] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+    if (global_row > 0) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index - n] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+    if (column + 1 < n) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index + 1] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+    if (column > 0) {
+        flux += (current_energy[index - 1] - energy) * TRANSFER_COEFF * 1.0 * 0.25;
+    }
+
+    next_energy[index] = energy + flux;
+    next_total_flux[index] = current_total_flux[index] + fabs(flux);

+int runSimulation(DeviceState& state, const Partition& partition, int n, int n_iters,
+                  bool cuda_aware_mpi) {
+    cudaStream_t compute_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaStream_t communication_stream = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t update_complete = nullptr;
+    cudaEvent_t halos_ready = nullptr;
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&compute_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&communication_stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&update_complete, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&halos_ready, cudaEventDisableTiming));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+
+    const bool staged_halos = !cuda_aware_mpi &&
+                              (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL ||
+                               partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL);
+    HostHalos host_halos(n, staged_halos);
+    const size_t row_bytes = static_cast<size_t>(n) * sizeof(val_t);
+    const dim3 threads(CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    const dim3 column_blocks((n + CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE - 1) / CUDA_BLOCK_SIZE);
+    int current = 0;
+
+    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < n_iters; ++iteration) {
+        const int next = 1 - current;
+        val_t* current_energy = state.energy[current];
+        val_t* current_flux = state.total_flux[current];
+        val_t* next_energy = state.energy[next];
+        val_t* next_flux = state.total_flux[next];
+
+        if (partition.previous_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL &&
+            partition.next_rank == MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 0, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+            current = next;
+            continue;
+        }
+
+        MPI_Request requests[4];
+        int request_count = 0;
+
+        if (cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            // MPI may not observe work in a non-default CUDA stream, so make only
+            // the preceding boundary update visible before handing it pointers.
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 18,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy + n, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(current_energy +
+                                        static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                    n, MPI_DOUBLE, partition.next_rank, 17,
+                                    MPI_COMM_WORLD, &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        } else {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Irecv(host_halos.receive_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(communication_stream, update_complete, 0));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_previous,
+                                           current_energy + n, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(host_halos.send_next,
+                                           current_energy +
+                                               static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows) * n,
+                                           row_bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+        }
+
+        // Interior rows do not depend on incoming halos and overlap communication.
+        if (partition.rows > 2) {
+            const dim3 grid(column_blocks.x, partition.rows - 2);
+            updateRowsKernel<<<grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+                current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+                n, 1, partition.rows - 2, partition.first_row);
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        }
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(communication_stream));
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_previous, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.previous_rank, 18, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                MPI_CHECK(MPI_Isend(host_halos.send_next, n, MPI_DOUBLE,
+                                    partition.next_rank, 17, MPI_COMM_WORLD,
+                                    &requests[request_count++]));
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Waitall(request_count, requests, MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE));
+
+        if (!cuda_aware_mpi) {
+            if (partition.previous_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(current_energy,
+                                           host_halos.receive_previous, row_bytes,
+                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                                           communication_stream));
+            }
+            if (partition.next_rank != MPI_PROC_NULL) {
+                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(
+                    current_energy + static_cast<size_t>(partition.rows + 1) * n,
+                    host_halos.receive_next, row_bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice,
+                    communication_stream));
+            }
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(halos_ready, communication_stream));
+            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(compute_stream, halos_ready, 0));
+        }
+
+        const unsigned int boundary_rows = partition.rows == 1 ? 1U : 2U;
+        const dim3 boundary_grid(column_blocks.x, boundary_rows);
+        updateBoundaryRowsKernel<<<boundary_grid, threads, 0, compute_stream>>>(
+            current_energy, current_flux, next_energy, next_flux,
+            n, partition.rows, partition.first_row);
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(update_complete, compute_stream));
+        current = next;
+    }
+
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(halos_ready));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventDestroy(update_complete));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(communication_stream));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(compute_stream));
+    return current;
+}

+uint64_t doubleBits(val_t value) {
+    uint64_t bits = 0;
+    static_assert(sizeof(bits) == sizeof(value));
+    std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
+    return bits;
